notes.title: Pubblety graduated!
notes.content:
Happy International Cat Day! And not only:


It has been... 3 years... of a great journey.

And with today, I officially graduated from Game Design University with a Bachelor's degree,

with Pubblety as my graduation thesis/project. He did good. Extremely good. Ultimate Domination.



Though this marks the end of one journey, others are just beginning.

Works on Mr. Pubblety Meows are only just beginning, so-

See you all out there~
